abstract: In order to elucidate the inhibitory regulation of hCG synthesis, the dynamics of the synthesis and secretion of hCG was investigated by culturing explants of trophoblastic tissues from early placenta and choriocarcinoma in the presence and absence of progesterone, and these results were then compared to those of hPL. The dynamics of mRNAs encoding hCG (alpha, beta) and hPL was assessed by grain counts in the tissue sections hybridized in situ with labelled cDNA probes corresponding to these mRNAs. In the control culture of early placenta, hCG, hCG alpha and hPL in the medium showed marked increases compared to the initial tissue levels, whereas hCG, hCG alpha and immunoreactive hCG beta in the tissue explants remained constant. Progesterone suppressed the secretion of hCG and hCG alpha by placental tissue after 48-hour culture in a dose-response manner and simultaneously decreased the tissue level of immunoreactive hCG beta. However, neither hPL secretion nor hPL tissue level were decreased by progesterone. The in situ hybridization revealed that grain counts for hCG alpha-mRNA and hCG beta-mRNA in the sections prepared from placenta cultured with progesterone were decreased compared to those prepared without progesterone, whereas grain counts for hPL-mRNA remained unchanged. In culture of explants from chorio-carcinoma, no inhibition of synthesis and secretion of hCG by progesterone was found. From these results it will be concluded that progesterone inhibits hCG synthesis through the inhibition of hCG alpha-mRNA and hCG beta-mRNA accumulation and that regulation of hCG synthesis in choriocarcinoma is different from that in the normal placenta.
abstract_ja: 早期胎盤および絨毛癌の組織外植片を、プロゲステロンの存在下および非存在下で培養し、hCGの合成と分泌の動態を検討した。比較のためhPLも検討した。対照として培養した早期胎盤では、培地中のhCG、hCGα、hPLは組織の初期レベルに比べて著明に増加したが、組織外植片中のhCG、hCGα、免疫反応性hCGβは一定に保たれた。プロゲステロンは48時間培養後、用量依存的に胎盤組織によるhCGおよびhCGαの分泌を抑制し、同時に免疫反応性hCGβの組織内レベルを低下させた。しかしhPLの分泌および組織内レベルはプロゲステロンによって低下しなかった。cDNAプローブを用いたin situハイブリダイゼーションでは、プロゲステロン存在下で培養した胎盤切片のhCGα-mRNAおよびhCGβ-mRNAのグレインカウントは、非存在下に比べて低下したが、hPL-mRNAは変化しなかった。絨毛癌の外植片培養では、プロゲステロンによるhCG合成・分泌の抑制は認められなかった。これらの結果から、プロゲステロンはhCGα-mRNAおよびhCGβ-mRNAの蓄積を抑制することでhCG合成を阻害すると結論する。また絨毛癌におけるhCG合成の調節は、正常胎盤とは異なると考えられる。
